summary: Implemented the window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for title controls. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Tests were not run, per instructions; nothing was committed.
